_comment: Hand-made 'explain' object for FLD sheet 051 (C10265H/P3) used to exercise the viewer. Text, net, shape and link ids are the real ones from the drawing data; the wording follows what is written on the sheet. It describes part of the sheet only (outputs 3B and 3P, input 3A, DeltaV point DV3_5, the ISOCON 6 converter and window W12).
summary: Functional logic diagram 051 (FLD - No.3 PLANT COPPER DISSOLVING AREA). Field devices in the left column are read by ANALOG I/P F6217 and DIGITAL I/P F3236 modules; their software signals go through AND, OR and timer symbols to continuation boxes (3B to sheet 052, 3P to sheet 053), to annunciator windows and to DeltaV Modbus taps. Signal 3A arrives from sheet 052. This fixture covers only part of the sheet.
facts: Output 3B -> sheet 052: AND of eight inputs: OR(3A (from 052), 03HZS03350 P/B 'C'), OR(AND(03HZA03350=T1 OFF 2 mins(03HZS03350 P/B 'C'), 03HZS03354 P/B 'F'), AND(03HZS03354 P/B 'F', 03FZA03002, 03FZA03004, 03FZA03006A, 03QZA03581, 03LZA03691, 03FZA03007, 03FZA03008, 03FZA03010)), 03FZA03012, 03PDZA03078, HIGH 03TZA03052A, OR(03EZS03412, 03EZS03413), HIGH 03LZA03110A, OR(MID 03LZA03110C, 03HZA03559) (link verified).
Output 3P -> sheet 053: AND(03HZA03350=T1 OFF 2 mins(03HZS03350 P/B 'C' [no signal name]), 03HZS03354 P/B 'F' [no signal name]) (link multiple: two boxes 3P exist on sheet 053).
Signal 3A arrives from sheet 052 (pointer 052.225, link verified) and feeds an OR gate; used in 3B, DV3_1, DV3_5.
Output 03ZRT03581: V TO I ISOCON 6(03QZT03581 (1-5V)) -> 03ZRT03581, cable 3/C735 terminals 1 & 2.
DeltaV points: DV3_5 is tapped on the 3B output wire; DV3_1 on the output of the OR gate taking 3A; DV3_2 on the output of the AND gate making 3P.
Annunciator W12: 03HZA03350=T1 OFF 2 mins(03HZS03350 P/B 'C' [no signal name]). Annunciator W01: 03FZA03002.
Input 03FZT03002 Nitric Acid, LOOP TYPE AI1, cable 3/C650 terminals 1 & 2, read by ANALOG I/P F6217, signals 03FZA03002.

Input 03HZS03350 LOW FLOWS RESET, LOOP TYPE DI1, cable 3/C654 terminals 4 & 11, console push button P/B 'C' in the CONTROL ROOM, read by DIGITAL I/P F3236; no signal name is written on its output wire.

Input 03HZS03354 COPPER DISSOLVING STOP, LOOP TYPE DI1, cable 3/C654 terminals 8 & 11, console push button P/B 'F' in the CONTROL ROOM, read by DIGITAL I/P F3236; no signal name is written on its output wire.
The timer box reads T1 OFF and 2 mins; its output wire is labelled 03HZA03350.
This explanation is a hand-made test fixture and covers part of sheet 051 only.
